name: Cross-account scoped sts:AssumeRole (positive; conditioned; hostile ARN rides through inert)
note: S2-crossaccount-scoped-surface (A): a scoped sts:AssumeRole to a specific role in ANOTHER account (999999999999) than the analyzed principal (context.subjectAccount 123456789012). detectAssumeRoleExpansion treats a single named role as routine and stays quiet WITHIN an account, so this cross-account transition otherwise read CLEAN. CROSS-ACCOUNT-ASSUME-ROLE fires at LOW, only because the subject account is known via context. A narrowing sts:ExternalId Condition is present (the finding still fires, conditioned), and the target role ARN embeds an HTML/JS payload that must survive verbatim in the finding's resources as inert DATA. Same-account scoped assume stays QUIET; exploitability depends on the target role's trust policy + permissions, which are out of scope.
